temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Maria offers help, and Cheryl accepts, saying she could definitely use it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had noticed signs that Cheryl was stressed or overwhelmed, but she did not yet know whether Cheryl wanted assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns that Cheryl is overwhelmed and receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs help with the outreach project and that Maria can provide useful support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and empathy, with willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. In a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase; Cheryl thanks her and says she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl had been overwhelmed and accepted her help, but she is not yet certain how well Cheryl will handle larger responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria observes Cheryl’s improved handling and growing confidence, and Cheryl accepts the leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is capable, committed, and ready to lead the next phase.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Pride and confidence in Cheryl, with optimism.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl’s leadership and the project’s next phase.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately approaches Cheryl to make sure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured. Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria’s support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl is capable and ready to lead, but she worries her suggestion may have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl reassures Maria that she appreciated the support and did not take offense.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl feels supported rather than pressured and that there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry and concern before the conversation; relief and reassurance afterward.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clarify her intentions, reassure Cheryl, and maintain a supportive relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together. Cheryl agrees enthusiastically and says Maria’s guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and that their relationship is positive, but she proposes co-leading to continue collaboration in a mutually supportive way.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl welcomes co-leading and explicitly values Maria’s guidance and teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes co-leading is welcome and that she and Cheryl work well as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for future projects, and Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria already believes their collaboration is fruitful and their partnership has grown strong through co-leading and previous work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; the event confirms and strengthens Maria’s belief in their partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes their partnership is strong and that future collaboration with Cheryl will be positive and productive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
